maas: available from DeepSeek to use in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. To access a DeepSeek model, go to its Model Garden model card. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model from DeepSeek built for agentic and coding tasks. It accepts text and image input and has a context window of up to 1M tokens. Go to the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model card Use DeepSeek models For managed models, you can use curl commands to send requests to the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform endpoint using the following model names: For DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, use deepseek-v4.1-flash-maas To learn how to make streaming and non-streaming calls to DeepSeek models, see Call open model APIs . To use a self-deployed Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform model: Navigate to the Model Garden console . Find the relevant Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform model. Click Enable and complete the provided form to get the necessary commercial use licenses. For more information about deploying and using partner models, see Deploy a partner model and make prediction requests .
